name: setAgentLoopSettings
description: Push agent-loop runtime tunables (per-action wall-clock budget, per-step budget, default cwd) onto the matching ToolSession. Lazily creates the session if absent so JS can push settings before the first tool call. Resolves with the applied values after C++-side clamping. Phase 12f moved this off the manual `browser.setAgentLoopSettings` handler in tools_adapter onto the codegen-driven session capability.

inputs.name: actionTimeoutMs
inputs.description: Per-action wall-clock budget. Default if unset is 180000 ms (matches Browser-Use).

inputs.name: stepTimeoutMs
inputs.description: Per-step (full agent-loop iteration) budget. Default 600000 ms.

inputs.name: cwd
inputs.description: Optional default working directory for shell-style tools (Bash / Glob / Grep / Read / Write / Edit). Must be absolute; relative paths are silently ignored so a partial settings push doesn't clobber a previously-set cwd.

inputs.name: clearReadState
inputs.description: If true, clear the session's native Read/Edit/Write read-state cache. Used after /compact or /clear because earlier Read content may no longer be visible in model context.

inputs.name: browserObservationDiffOptIn
inputs.description: New-guest handshake for the browser observation short-circuit (T0-c). Set true once at boot to allow the host to collapse an unchanged working-tab observation to an {unchanged,count} stub. Omitted by older guests, so the host keeps sending full observations for them.

inputs.name: clearBrowserObservationCache
inputs.description: If true, mark the browser observation cache stale so the next observation is sent full instead of an {unchanged} stub. The guest pushes it on its first settings push per engine instance (session open / restore / fork — the C++ ToolSession may be warm from an earlier guest lifetime while the transcript was reloaded from storage) and after /clear, /compact and autocompact — the stub's baseline observation may no longer be in model context. Try-again resumes in place and does not push it.

inputs.name: executionContext
inputs.description: Per-session metadata. Only `sessionId` is consulted; missing / empty falls through to '__default__'.

inputs.name: sessionId
inputs.description: Legacy top-level session id. Preferred path is `executionContext.sessionId`.
